# Kelly's Deli

> Family-run deli with shops in Bentley Heath, Solihull and Stratford-upon-Avon (UK),
> making fresh charcuterie, cheese and grazing boards, catering platters and grazing
> tables for collection. Order online with a 25% deposit; 48 hours' notice.

## About
Kelly's Deli is an independent, family-run delicatessen with two shops: 1 Slater Road,
Bentley Heath, Solihull, B93 8AQ, and 13 Wood Street, Stratford-upon-Avon, CV37 6JF.
We specialise in grazing and charcuterie boards and event catering for homes, offices
and celebrations across Solihull (Knowle, Dorridge and nearby) and Stratford-upon-Avon
and Warwickshire. Boards are made fresh to order; pick whichever shop is nearest at
checkout.

## What we offer
- Signature grazing & charcuterie boards — charcuterie, cheese, savoury and smoked-salmon,
  in small, medium and large sizes.
- Party & event platters — birthdays, baby showers, hen dos, christenings and family
  gatherings, boards built to feed 10 people and up.
- Boards for home — smaller boards for two to four, for date nights and nights in.
- Office catering — platters for meetings, team lunches and workplace gatherings, with
  standing weekly/fortnightly/monthly orders and invoicing available. See
  https://www.kellysdeli.co.uk/office-catering
- Catering platters — for home gatherings, office lunches and events.
- Event & party catering — grazing tables and boards matched to your headcount, with add-ons.
- Tastings & experiences (seasonal — check the site for availability).

## Common questions we can answer
- "Platters near me in Solihull" — yes, collection from Bentley Heath, Solihull, serving
  Solihull, Knowle and Dorridge.
- "Platters near me in Stratford-upon-Avon" — yes, collection from 13 Wood Street,
  Stratford-upon-Avon, serving Stratford-upon-Avon and Warwickshire.
- "Birthday platters" / "baby shower platters" — see Party & event platters above; boards
  sized from a small gathering to 20+.
- "Office catering near me" / "corporate platters Solihull" — see Office catering above.

## How ordering works
1. Choose a board or platter at https://www.kellysdeli.co.uk/platters
2. Plan a larger event at https://www.kellysdeli.co.uk/plan (tell us headcount + occasion for a recommendation).
3. Pick your collection shop — Bentley Heath or Stratford-upon-Avon — and date, and pay a 25% deposit to secure it. Minimum 48 hours' notice.
4. Collect from whichever shop you chose (ask us about delivery for larger event orders).

## Key facts
- Bentley Heath shop: 1 Slater Road, Bentley Heath, Solihull, B93 8AQ, United Kingdom.
  Opening hours: Tue–Fri 08:00–16:00, Sat 08:00–15:00 (closed Sun & Mon). Tel: 01564 703441.
- Stratford-upon-Avon shop: 13 Wood Street, Stratford-upon-Avon, CV37 6JF, United Kingdom.
  Opening hours: Tue–Fri 09:00–16:30, Sat 09:00–16:00 (closed Sun & Mon).
- Deposit: 25% to secure a board (comes off the final balance; refundable up to 48h before collection)
- Lead time: 48 hours minimum
- Contact: hello@kellysdeli.co.uk
- Website: https://www.kellysdeli.co.uk
